cues: And now the cold pack makes sense.
Dissolving ammonium chloride is uphill in energy, plus fifteen point one kilojoules.
But an ordered crystal breaking into freely moving ions is a huge increase in entropy.
At room temperature, T delta S beats delta H, so delta G is negative.
The reaction is driven not by energy, but by disorder.
That is the second driving force of chemistry.
